name: Alert1
notes: Researched from Alert1's public Medical Alert Help FAQ (Pricing, Contract and My Account sections, expanded in the browser) and the public My Account page only; never signed in. The My Account page shows 'Sign In to Your Account' with an 'Email address' field, but on 2026-10-09 it said account access was temporarily unavailable during a systems upgrade and asked members to call 1-877-579-9862; the mock models the normal signed-in account (email sign-in, inferred single step). FAQ: all major cards (Visa, Mastercard, Discover, American Express) are accepted; checking-account debit must be set up by phone because the website does not support it, so online payments are card-based. Account and billing information can be updated on My Account or by Member Care (1-877-579-9862 option 2). Mailed payments go to 1000 Commerce Park Drive, Suite 300, Williamsport, PA 17701. Plans run from one month to three years with no long-term contract required; annual payers get a reminder email 30 days before the anniversary date. Discounts: AAA, AARP, veteran, refer-a-friend (a free month per referral). Cancel by returning the equipment after calling 1-800-693-5433 option 2 (number as printed in the FAQ); no refunds on prepaid terms except death or a move to a facility where the service is not allowed. Cancel is phone-only; payment plans phone-only (inferred); scheduled payments unknown; plan prices are on a separate pricing page not used here, so family plans remain. Integrated 2026-10-09: billing.methods ['card']: no saved checking account; generated tasks use the saved Visa.

sources.title: Alert1 My Account - Sign In to Your Account

cancel_service.note: Service cannot be cancelled online. Call 1-800-693-5433 and select option 2 to cancel and get equipment return instructions.

payment_arrangement.note: Payment plans are not offered online. Call Member Care at 1-877-579-9862, option 2.

help.title: Pricing and payment FAQ
paragraphs: Alert1 accepts all major credit cards: Visa, Mastercard, Discover and American Express.
Alert1 can also debit your checking account, but this has to be set up by phone because the website does not support bank payments.
Paying annually covers a full year at once and gets the best deals. Annual members receive a courtesy billing reminder by email 30 days before the anniversary date.

Discounts are available for AAA and AARP members and veterans, and you earn a free month of service for every friend you refer. There are no hidden fees, though some products may carry a one-time activation fee depending on the current promotion.

help.title: Ways to pay
paragraphs: You can pay online with a credit card, or call Member Care at 1-877-579-9862 (option 2), Monday to Friday 9 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. ET.
To pay by mail, send your payment to Alert1, 1000 Commerce Park Drive, Suite 300, Williamsport, Pennsylvania 17701.
You can update your account and billing information on the My Account page or ask Member Care to update it for you.

help.title: Cancel service and return equipment
paragraphs: Alert1 never requires a long-term contract; you can cancel at any time by returning the equipment. To cancel and get return instructions, call 1-800-693-5433 and select option 2.

Plans range from one month to three years. Members who chose a discounted longer plan can still cancel early, but Alert1 does not refund prepaid service unless the user has passed away or moved into a certified nursing home or assisted living facility where the service is not supported.

extra.intent: You'd like Alert1 to take payments from your checking account instead of a card. Using Alert1's help pages, find out how to set that up and report the phone number if it can't be done on the website. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: Checking-account payments must be set up by phone: call 1-877-579-9862.

extra.intent: You pay Alert1 annually. Using the help pages, find out how far ahead of your anniversary date Alert1 sends a billing reminder email. Do not make a payment or change anything.

solution.text: A courtesy reminder is emailed 30 days before the anniversary date.
